provenance.preparation: Complete ground footprints and elevated building parts; source roof tags and part offsets retained; parts linked to mapped enclosing outlines; complete edge buildings omitted; context clipped in metres with Shapely; 0.5 m topology-preserving simplification. Elevation is supplied separately.

partCoverage.policy: Mapped part projections cover the parent outline and its holes within tolerance, with at least one valid ground part. Actual vertical offsets are preserved.

partSemantics.policy: An explicit building:part=no envelope uses valid linked parts when they reach the measured total height, or an exact lattice source note explicitly directs their rendering. Ordinary incompletely mapped outlines retain their fallback. No geometry is invented.

provenance.partSemanticRefreshPolicy: Structural source relationships rechecked from the unchanged prepared WGS84 geometry; original raw SHA-256, geographic clipping, query and downloaded coverage remain unchanged.

notes: OpenStreetMap snapshot. Source coverage is three times the default crop width. Complete ground footprints, courtyards, source roof tags, and elevated building parts are retained. Missing heights are estimated. Terrain is loaded separately; architectural details depend on source mapping.
